title: Next Greater Element II
statement:
For each position in circular array `nums`, return the first value greater than it encountered while moving forward, wrapping around at most once. Return `-1` if no greater value exists. Preserve index order in the result.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1, 2, 1]
Output: [2, -1, 2]
```

```text
Input: nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 3]
Output: [2, 3, 4, -1, 4]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^4`
- `-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9`
